batch.description: Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University (HSTU) A Unit admission test, academic session 2015-2016 (Satt Academy labels it 'HSTU A Unit-2015'; the 2015-16 admission test was held 30 Nov-3 Dec 2015). PARTIAL extraction: Satt Academy lists 100 questions (Physics 25, Chemistry 26, Biology 24, English 25) but only subject page 1 (15 questions per subject, 60 total) is publicly accessible; pages 2+ redirect to a login page, so the remaining 40 questions could not be fetched and are NOT included. Question text, option order and the source's own printed correct answers (check-circle marker + hidden answer field, agreeing on all 60) are transcribed verbatim; MathML formulas linearized with ^ for superscripts and _ for subscripts. Answers are the question bank's own keys, NOT an official HSTU key, and content has not been cross-checked against an independent second source, so contentVerificationStatus is unverified. Known source data errors preserved as-is: Physics Q6 options b and c are identical in the source; Chemistry Q12 in the source carries the same four options as Chemistry Q11 (unrelated to its question text). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
